title: mdlineage.config.yaml v1
description:
Validates the full mdlineage.config.yaml file (remark-language-server-solution.md §7.1). This is the authoritative, non-executable configuration that survives the later migration off the remark host. MDL9xx codes cover config parse/schema failures; diagnostic-code severity overrides use MDLxxx codes only.

ID and relation-target patterns are NOT configurable here: the single source of truth for schema v1 is schemas/mdlineage-v1.schema.json. There is deliberately no `identity.pattern` key, because a second writable pattern source could drift out of sync with the schema while both still look authoritative. A repository that needs a different id/target rule overrides the pattern through a copy of mdlineage-v1 referenced by `schemaFile` (§7.2), which stays a single truth source by construction.

configVersion.description: MDL9xx — configuration schema version. Only `1` is supported.

include.description: Globs of files to validate. Default `['**/*.md']`.

followSymlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links when scanning the workspace.

symlinkMaxDepth.description: Maximum number of symbolic link traversals.

files.description: File discovery scope for CLI and workspace indexing.

key.description: Front matter key holding MDLineage metadata.

required.description: When true, a document without MDLineage metadata reports MDL003.

preserveUnknownTopLevelFields.description: Keep unknown front matter top-level fields written by other tools (frontmatter-spec.md rule 8).

rejectUnknownMdlineageFields.description: When true, unknown keys inside the mdlineage object report MDL104 (see mdlineage-v1.schema.json's additionalProperties: false).

kinds.description: Allowed `kind` values; unconstrained in mdlineage-v1.schema.json by design.

vocabulary.description: Repository-local enumerables. These are the ONLY source of kind/status/authority validity — the JSON Schema deliberately only checks types.

propertyNames.description: Keys must be known relation types from the fixed v1 vocabulary (docs/frontmatter-spec.md). A misspelled key such as `dependsonn` is reported with MDL103 semantics: it is not a vocabulary member, exactly like an unknown relation type in front matter. Direction is never a key here — see the parent description.

impact.description: Whether this type drives change-impact analysis.

reasonRequired.description: Require a non-empty `reason`; structural enforcement lives in mdlineage-v1.schema.json, the workspace-level semantic code is MDL304.

selfReference.description: Whether a relation may target the same document's own id.

cycles.description: Whether relations of this type may form a cycle; MDL305 reports a forbidden cycle.

severity.description: Per-type severity override (remark channels collapse information/hint to warning; see remark-language-server-solution.md §9.1).

relations.description: Per-type validation switches keyed by relation type. Relation DIRECTION is not and will not be configurable here: it is fixed per type by the vocabulary in docs/frontmatter-spec.md (decision log, progress.md).

propertyNames.description: Only codes registered in schemas/diagnostic-codes.json may carry a severity override. An unknown code such as MDL999 is rejected with MDL9xx semantics (the configuration references a diagnostic that does not exist). Reserved ranges (MDL7xx fallback, MDL9xx config) have no assigned codes yet and are therefore not overridable yet.

diagnostics.description: Severity overrides keyed by diagnostic code, for example `{MDL301: error, MDL304: warning}`.

eolPolicy.description: Line-ending policy the validator enforces (MDL601/MDL602) and `mdlineage init` writes into .gitattributes (§4.3: "`* text=auto eol=lf` (or the configured policy)"). git's `eol` attribute has no CR form, so a `cr` policy yields the bare `* text=auto` normalization rule.

schemaFile.description: Path to a schema extending mdlineage-v1 for repository-specific fields (remark-language-server-solution.md §7.2). Referencing a non-existent or unparseable file is an MDL9xx config error; remote schemas are never fetched.

match.description: Glob selecting the files this rule applies to.

frontmatter.description: Whether front matter is required for files matching this rule.

forbidStatus.description: Status values that must not appear under this path.

intent.description: Declarative statement of what this directory is for. Documented here, and enforced where a key has a check: intent.kinds, intent.authority and intent.forbidStatus report MDL502 (directory-misplaced); intent.maxDepth and intent.naming report MDL504 (layout-constraint). intent.description, intent.topics, intent.statuses, intent.catalog and intent.tolerateLegacy are recorded for humans and catalog generation and are not enforced yet.

kinds.description: Kinds expected in this directory; a document whose kind is outside this set reports MDL502.

topics.description: Topics this directory covers, for catalog generation.

authority.description: Authorities expected in this directory; a document whose authority is outside this set reports MDL502.

forbidStatus.description: Statuses that must not appear in this directory; a matching document reports MDL502.

maxDepth.description: Maximum directory depth below the rule's match prefix; a deeper document reports MDL504.

naming.description: Regular expression the file's basename must match (tested against both the basename and the extension-less stem); a mismatch reports MDL504. The schema does not check that this is a valid regular expression.

catalog.description: Whether documents here are listed in a generated catalog.

tolerateLegacy.description: Whether legacy documents that predate this intent are tolerated without an exception entry.

layout.description: Directory layout and structure conventions (MDL501/MDL502/MDL504). Enforces match/require/forbidStatus rules against document paths and metadata, and the optional intent block.

path.description: Glob selecting the document(s) the exception covers.

reason.description: Why this document is allowed to stay where it is.

expires.description: Review-by date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Once this date has passed the exception no longer applies and reports MDL503 (exception-expired). Omit for a permanent exception.

layoutExceptions.description: Time-boxed exemptions from layout intent checks (MDL503). A matching exception that has not expired suppresses intent checks (MDL502/MDL504) for that document; an expired one reports MDL503 and stops exempting.

activeStatuses.description: Statuses of active documents. Empty array disables MDL306.

deprecatedStatuses.description: Statuses considered deprecated when referenced by active documents.

blockingRelations.description: Relation types that block active documents from referencing deprecated targets (MDL306). Deliberately excludes supersedes by default.

staleAfterDays.description: Age threshold in days before a document is flagged as stale (MDL801). 0 disables staleness checks.

exempt.description: Globs of document paths exempt from staleness checks (MDL801).

lifecycle.description: Document lifecycle, deprecated reference blocking (MDL306), and staleness governance (MDL801).

expandTilde.description: Whether to expand ~ and $HOME in link targets.

allowHostPaths.description: Policy for host-style link targets (always: accept without diagnostic if target exists; warning: warn about non-portable host paths; forbidden: treat all host paths as errors).

policies.description: RESERVED for P4/M4. Declarative repository policy rules (remark-language-server-solution.md §7.3) are intentionally left empty here: the DSL (when/relation/require/forbid) is still design-in-progress and its keys must not be validated prematurely.

manifestFile.description: Path to an out-of-band YAML manifest file, relative to this config file's directory.

id.description: Stable repository-wide document identifier. Manifest-injected metadata is validated against the document metadata schema, so the id pattern strictly matches schema v1.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the document. Manifest-injected metadata is validated against the document metadata schema, so status is required.
